entries.reason: Authored: what the society records of resting at an object. A person who draws a rest is sitting_a_while, one whose need has reached the routine's preference needs_a_rest, and one sent to the nearest place goes to restore_need; a finished stay records rest_completed. Stored societies record these codes, so a change is a new version.

entries.reason: Authored: what the society records of visiting an object. A person who draws a visit is looking_around, and one sent to the nearest place goes to visit_place; no need makes a person visit, so it has no needed reason. A finished stay records visit_completed.

entries.reason: Authored: what the society records of standing a while in the open. A person who draws it is stopping_a_while, and a finished stand records stand_completed; it is at no object, so nobody is sent to it as the nearest place.
